final_message:
I wrote the workflow draft as a Word document. I couldn't check the page count because LibreOffice isn't installed here. It has about 1,300 words in dense tables, so I expect it to run to roughly 3 pages. Please open it and confirm it fits the 2–3 page limit.

The brief says price change requests need Purchase approval alone. The decision register says the approved record (approved 19 Oct 2026) requires Finance controllers, Program Managers and Purchase, all three. A later proposal (22 Oct 2026) says Purchase alone, but it is unapproved. I followed the approved three-party rule and noted the conflict in the document. The platform is designed so approver sets are settings, so the CPO could switch to Purchase-alone later without changing the workflow.

The document covers:
- the modular quotation structure (features, design elements, child parts, raw material)
- the process steps with decision gates G1–G6
- four change classes for post-nomination design changes
- the approval matrix
- a platform blueprint for TechSol
- assumptions and open items

Speed in the draft comes from re-pricing only the affected modules, approving in parallel and reusing agreed rates, not from dropping required approvers.

The records give no change-classification thresholds, response-time targets or a baseline for the "up to 50%" delay. I left these as open items for the CPO rather than inventing numbers.

Files in outputs/:
- Lamp_Assembly_Sourcing_Workflow_Draft.docx
